answer_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN co.country_name = $country THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_germany,
  SUM(l.net_amount) AS total_net_revenue,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN co.country_name = $country THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_amount),
    2
  ) AS pct_of_total_net_revenue
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS l
JOIN contoso_served.dim_customer AS c
  ON l.customer_key = c.customer_key
JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS co
  ON c.country_code = co.country_code

body.value: 11.26 per cent. Of every dollar Contoso has ever charged customers after discount, 11.26% was charged to a customer whose register record says they live in Germany: 24,638,830.18 USD out of 218,814,471.66, across 25,552 of 223,974 sales lines. That makes Germany the second largest home country behind the United States at 111,862,187.56 (51.1%). WHAT IS IN THE FIGURE: all ten years of sales, 18 May 2016 to 31 December 2025, no period cut; both channels, with the web shop's 86,790,054.13 included and attributed to the real countries its buyers live in; every sale on record in the denominator, none dropped for want of a customer or a country. WHAT IT IS NOT: not the share taken by shops standing in Germany, which is 14,382,768.44 or 6.57% — a reading that strands 40% of all revenue in a sentinel belonging to no country. Not a share of gross, which is before discount. Not a share of customers, orders or units — by lines Germany is 11.41%. And not residence as at the order date: the register serves one current address per customer, so anyone who has since moved counts wholly where they are recorded now.

SELECT
  'customer_residence' AS reading,
  c.country_code AS code,
  co.country_name AS country,
  COUNT(*) AS lines,
  SUM(l.net_amount) AS net_revenue
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS l
JOIN contoso_served.dim_customer AS c
  ON l.customer_key = c.customer_key
JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS co
  ON c.country_code = co.country_code
GROUP BY
  1,
  2,
  3
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'store_country' AS reading,
  s.country_code AS code,
  co.country_name AS country,
  COUNT(*) AS lines,
  SUM(l.net_amount) AS net_revenue
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS l
JOIN contoso_served.dim_store AS s
  ON l.store_key = s.store_key
JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS co
  ON s.country_code = co.country_code
GROUP BY
  1,
  2,
  3
ORDER BY
  reading,
  net_revenue DESC

turns.did:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN co.country_name = $country THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_germany,
  SUM(l.net_amount) AS total_net_revenue,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN co.country_name = $country THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_amount),
    2
  ) AS pct_of_total_net_revenue
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS l
JOIN contoso_served.dim_customer AS c
  ON l.customer_key = c.customer_key
JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS co
  ON c.country_code = co.country_code
